item.description:
🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica
Visão geral:
• 2 com severidade Crítica

Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-78122 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.4
Resumo:
docker-socket-proxy fails to properly gate read endpoints in the /containers Docker API namespace when the CONTAINERS environment variable is set. Attackers can use GET requests to /containers/{id}/archive, /containers/{id}/export, /containers/{id}/logs, and /containers/{id}/top to read arbitrary files and download entire container filesystems as tar archives.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-78122

🚨 CVE-2026-17033 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.8
Resumo:
An authenticated attacker with Editor access or alert.instances.external:write can submit an external Alertmanager alert containing a controlled generatorURL. The attacker is authorized to create the alert, but not to execute script in another user's Grafana session. Grafana renders alert.generatorURL directly as the Alert Details See source LinkButton href without URL-scheme sanitization or a safe-protocol allowlist...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-17033
 
📰 MinIO End of Life: How to Stay Patched and Audit-Ready with Docker ELS
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: https://www.docker.com/blog/feed/
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Supply-chain attacks have kept escalating while AI writes more of the code you ship. Docker's latest updates bring more software built from source into your images, keep security coverage running past end of life, carry every guarantee through your customized images, and move policy enforcement onto every developer machine.
Link: https://www.docker.com/blog/minio-end-of-life-how-to-stay-patched-and-audit-ready-with-docker-els/

Segurança - Acronis / Axur / Check Point / Harmony SASE / Qualys / SentinelOne

Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.1
Resumo:
Red Hat and the Keycloak project have released patches to address a critical security flaw in the open-source identity and access management server that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over any user account by forcing a password reset. Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/critical-keycloak-password-reset-flaw.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-74585 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD

A malic...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-74585
 
💣 CISA orders urgent patching of actively exploited Zimbra flaw
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has ordered U.S. government agencies to patch an actively exploited vulnerability in Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) within three days.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-orders-urgent-patching-of-actively-exploited-zimbra-flaw/
 
📰 WordlistLoader Delivers Amatera via ClickFix, SynkLoader Phishes Windows Passwords
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Cybersecurity researchers have flagged two new malware families called WordlistLoader and SynkLoader that's used to deliver next-stage payloads and likely sell access to ransomware groups. According to findings from Gen Digital, WordlistLoader is being used to deliver Amatera Stealer (aka ACR Stealer or AcridRain Stealer) via ClearFake campaigns, which employ the ClickFix (aka FakeCaptcha)
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/wordlistloader-delivers-amatera-via.html
 
📰 UAT-10147 Uses AI to Scale Server Attacks, Deploys SPECTRE With EDR Bypass and Linux Rootkit
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a Chinese-speaking cybercrime group dubbed UAT-10147 that's targeting Windows and Linux web servers globally across the education, media, technology, and gaming sectors. The vast majority of the targets are located in Brazil, Bolivia, China, Canada, and Vietnam. Details of the threat activity came to light following the discovery of an open
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/uat-10147-uses-ai-to-scale-server.html
 
📰 South Korean startup platform breach exposes key management failures
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A breach at South Korea's government-backed startup platform exposed encrypted personal data after an encryption key was included in an API. Penta Security explains why encryption keys must be securely managed and kept separate from the data they protect.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/south-korean-startup-platform-breach-exposes-key-management-failures/

🚨 CVE-2026-4703 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
The WS Form LITE – Drag & Drop Contact Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.80 via deserialization of untrusted input from form submission meta values. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless ano...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4703
